dataHealth.title: Data health
dataHealth.help: Read-only ingestion, coverage and worker diagnostics. Updates every 30 seconds. Unknown evidence is never treated as healthy.
dataHealth.cached: Showing the last successful snapshot; refresh failed.
dataHealth.marketNote: Scanned {scanned} of {total} non-blacklisted tokens. A source-linked reading older than 15 minutes is stale; unknown/imported rows are not trusted. Inactive or unsupported tokens may have no market reading.
dataHealth.analysisNote: Candidates are normally considered within one hour and still subject to token cooldown, per-run limits and budget. Candidate counts are not a promise of analysis. Analysis is research, not a trading instruction.
dataHealth.workerNote: Failure counts include retained historical jobs, even after recovery. Missing retained timestamps do not prove a worker is stopped. Worker counts and backlog are current observations.
dataHealth.unknownIssue: An unrecognized diagnostic was reported; refresh or review server diagnostics.
dataHealth.noIssues: No issues detected in this snapshot. This is not proof of complete ingestion or provider availability.

issues.AI_MODEL_PLACEHOLDER: A configured AI model is empty or a placeholder (gpt-6-luna / gpt-6-sol) and will be rejected by the provider. Change the model names in Admin AI settings; saved ai.models settings override AI_MODEL_ID.
issues.AI_RUN_SKIPPED: The last retained analysis run was skipped. Check its reason: no_provider means the worker lacks a provider key; disabled means analysis was off; budget means its daily allowance was exhausted. Restart workers with the correct environment if needed.
issues.QUEUES_UNAVAILABLE: Queue diagnostics are unavailable. Check Redis and API connectivity before interpreting missing results.
issues.WORKER_MISSING: A configured queue has no connected worker. Start the full pipeline worker and check its startup logs.
issues.RETAINED_FAILURES: Some queues retain failed jobs. Compare the failure and completion timestamps: an old failure may already be recovered. Review worker logs before retrying anything.
issues.AI_PROVIDER_FAILURES: The latest retained analysis run reported provider failures. Check saved model IDs, provider access and worker logs; do not assume an analysis will arrive.
issues.PROVIDER_RATE_LIMIT: A latest retained collector run reported rate limiting. Reduce request pressure or wait for provider limits to reset; inspect worker logs.
issues.MARKET_COVERAGE_GAPS: Some scanned tokens have stale or unverified market readings. Check market collection and provider coverage; unsupported or inactive tokens can legitimately remain unavailable.
issues.TOKEN_NAMES_MISSING: Some tokens still have placeholder names. Check metadata collection; unavailable metadata stays unknown rather than being invented.
issues.AI_DISABLED: Opportunity analysis is switched off in saved settings.
issues.AI_NOT_CONFIGURED: The analysis provider is not configured. Set the server-side provider key and restart workers; never put it in public web configuration.
issues.ANALYSIS_BUDGET_EXHAUSTED: Today's analysis token budget is exhausted or zero. Review the budget in admin settings or wait for the next UTC day. Trading safeguards remain unchanged.

enhance.analysisCoverage: No analysis was saved for this record. Scheduled analysis normally considers scores of 50 or above recorded within the last hour, with a per-token cooldown. Provider availability and the daily budget also apply; waiting does not guarantee analysis for every record.
enhance.priceCoverage: Only source-linked price observations are shown. History builds as the collector runs; older unverified records are excluded. This is sampled market data, not an exchange candle feed.
enhance.priceCapped: Showing at most the latest 500 stored readings in this range.
enhance.noPriceHistory: No source-linked price observations in this range yet. Try a longer range or wait for the next collection.
enhance.priceLineNote: Lines connect recorded observations, not candles. Dashed bridges span collection gaps or pool switches; prices between observed points are not recorded.
enhance.eventCoverage: Market observations and recorded assessments, newest first. Pool creation is a provider-reported timestamp.
enhance.noObservedEvents: No recorded observations are available yet.
enhance.ideasBody: Review recorded research ideas: the narrative behind a token, the model's assessment and the evidence you still need. Use Tokens to compare raw market data.
enhance.ideaCoverage: Coverage: latest idea per token among the newest 500 records.
enhance.noIdeas: No recorded ideas are available for your account yet. Explore Tokens and Radar while the research pipeline collects evidence.
enhance.quoteSeparate: This quote is separate from the historical idea. A fresh price does not validate an old score or decision.
enhance.discoverBody: Track narratives and tokens through exact NEAR contract identities.
enhance.evaluateBody: Read price, liquidity, holder concentration and risk timestamps.
enhance.verifyBody: Mark missing or stale observations unknown, not zero.
enhance.capBasis: Market cap uses the latest observed value. FDV is labeled where the provider reports it.
enhance.historyNote: These retained records may include development history. Their prices and model scores are not current signals. Records are retained for linked account and analysis history.

trench.tokensBody: A source-backed NEAR market scan. Compare liquidity, activity and pool age before opening a token.
trench.opportunitiesBody: Build a memecoin watchlist from observed market conditions. These are research candidates, not buy signals.
trench.coverage: DEX Screener snapshots, refreshed on a 5-minute schedule. Only source-linked observations less than 15 minutes old enter this scan. This is sampled NEAR pool coverage, not every launch or a memecoin classification.
trench.noMarket: No current source-backed market observations match this view. Check collector status or try another filter. Historical values are not substituted.
trench.turnoverNote: Volume / liquidity is 24h traded volume divided by current pool liquidity, not unique buying demand. High turnover can include bots or wash trading. Pool creation is a proxy, not token mint time. FDV is labeled when market cap is unavailable.
trench.historyNote: These records may include development history and are not current signals. Check timestamps and source links before interpreting them.
trench.context: Market observations and social coverage are sampled. Check timestamps, valuation basis and source links.

runtime.title: Runtime settings
runtime.help: Public sign-in configuration and extra browser origins. Changes are audited and propagate within 20 seconds; reload the page to use a new Privy app.
runtime.originsHelp: One exact HTTP(S) origin per line, no paths or wildcards. Environment origins always remain allowed.
runtime.override: Override failed or unreachable Privy check (audited; may break sign-in)
runtime.recovery: Changing apps creates different user identities; make your new user admin. For lockout recovery in the configured API terminal:
runtime.checked: The public key matches this Privy app. Nothing was saved.
runtime.saved: Runtime settings saved. Reload after at most 20 seconds; no web rebuild is needed.
runtime.mismatch: Privy does not publish this key for the App ID. Check both values or explicitly override the check.
runtime.unreachable: Privy could not be reached. Retry later or explicitly override the check.
runtime.invalid: Invalid settings. Use a valid App ID, a complete P-256 public PEM key, and exact browser origins.
runtime.unauthorized: Admin access is required. Sign in again with an admin account.
runtime.rateLimited: Too many requests. Wait a minute and retry.
runtime.error: Runtime settings could not be loaded or saved. Please retry.

smartMoneyBody: Observed NEAR DEX wallets, ranked by realized results from trades this deployment has seen. Research only; a wallet is not endorsed.
smartMoneyNotice: Public on-chain observations, not a recommendation or proof that a wallet will repeat its results. The sample grows as the worker sees more trades.
smartMoneyAggregateNotice: Demo snapshot: this deployment shows the saved aggregate of observed DEX wallet activity. Individual wallet addresses and transaction hashes are not seeded, so the leaderboard below is intentionally unavailable.
smartMoneyAggregateLeaderboard: Individual wallet rows are omitted from this demo snapshot. The metrics above and the token flows below come from the same aggregate observation set; no wallet identity is inferred.
smartMoneyAggregateFlowsNote: Aggregate snapshot observed {from} to {to}. Unlike the live flow table, this is not limited to a 24-hour window and repeats the public thesis-desk aggregate.
smartMoneyMethodBody: The worker reads recent public NEAR pool trades from GeckoTerminal, keeps only trades for tokens in the research universe, and recalculates each affected wallet after every observation run. The feed is a recent window, not full history; history starts when collection starts.
smartMoneyMethodCost: Realized PnL uses average cost per token and only sells with an observed buy basis. Open positions are not marked to market. Sells with no observed buy, or sells larger than the observed position, are excluded from PnL and make the wallet ineligible.
smartMoneyMethodEntities: Wallets are ranked individually. This build does not infer common ownership or cluster wallets by funding source, so one entity can appear as several wallets.
smartMoneyMethodSource: Source: GeckoTerminal public NEAR pool trades. Provider-anomalous trades are excluded. Missing or unknown data stays unknown; it is never filled with a current price or a synthetic trade.
smartMoneyLeaderboardNote: Sorted by realized PnL, then win rate. Qualification requires enough closed trades, closed tokens, observed time, volume and a positive score. Open a wallet for its exact reasons.
smartMoneyEmpty: No wallet trades have been observed yet. The worker needs a completed market-data refresh and public DEX trades before this list can fill.
smartMoneyNoFlows: No token flows have been observed in this window yet.
smartMoneyFlowNote: Net flow = buy USD minus sell USD, observed {from} to {to}. It describes public swaps, not holder count or net token supply.
smartMoneyTruncated: The flow aggregation was capped; treat the list as partial.
smartMoneyWalletBody: Observed public DEX activity for {address}. This is not proof of ownership, identity or future performance.

smartMoneyStatusBody.QUALIFIED: This wallet meets the starting research thresholds. Qualification is not an endorsement or a prediction.
smartMoneyStatusBody.PROVISIONAL: This wallet has enough observations to profile but does not yet meet every qualification threshold.
smartMoneyStatusBody.INSUFFICIENT: This wallet does not have enough complete observations for a qualified smart-money profile yet.

smartMoneyReasons.VOLUME_BELOW_MINIMUM: observed volume is below the minimum

smartMoneyCostBasisNote: Realized PnL only includes observed closed positions with a known cost basis. Open positions, unmatched sells and provider-anomalous trades are excluded.
smartMoneyTradesNote: The latest 100 observed trades. Amounts and USD values are provider-reported at trade time; no current price is substituted.
smartMoneyTokenRowsCapped: Only the latest 1,000 token rows were read for this breakdown.
smartMoneyNoTrades: No observed trades for this wallet yet.
adminBody: Manage early access, feature access and research data health.
adminForbidden: This page is for admins only.

adminWhitelistHelp: Find a user by email, user id or Privy user id, then grant an early-access seat.
adminSearch: Email, user id or Privy id
adminNoUser: No user found. They need to sign in once, then an admin can grant access.

adminErrDisabled: Early access is turned off. Turn it on in settings first.
adminErrFull: All seats are taken. Raise the seat cap.

adminErrRate: Too many requests. Wait a moment and try again.

gateNoSeed: We never ask for your seed phrase.

errorBody: Check your connection and try again. Missing data is never replaced with sample values.

notFound: This research record was not found

noLive: Refresh to request a new snapshot. This view is not a live feed.

sourceLanguage: Research text is shown in the language returned by the source.
overviewTitle: A clearer view of the market.

opportunitiesBody: Compare the evidence, the uncertainty and the model reasoning. Recommendations do not execute orders.
tokensBody: Find a token by name, symbol or mint address.
rulesBrief: Generated from recorded facts using fixed rules.
name: Name
radarNote: Each marker is one narrative on this page; marker size is constant. Lifecycle stage is categorical, not elapsed time.
noRotation: No rotation detected in this window.
rotationNote: Describes past score changes, not a prediction. Thresholds are unvalidated starting values.
contextBody: Explore research and manage your access. Account trading controls belong to a later phase.
timelineGap: A full lifecycle timeline is not exposed by the current API.
ogNote: OG scores and creator relationships are estimates, not proof of origin.
creatorsCap: Only the first 50 related creators are shown.
noAnalysis: No analysis is available for this opportunity yet.
blacklistBody: This token is marked as blacklisted by the server.
historyGap: Historical candles and token event overlays are not exposed by the current API. Only the latest observation is shown; no price path or events are invented.
eventsGap: Event history is unavailable, not an empty or verified-safe event log.
noFlags: No flags recorded in this snapshot. This is not a safety guarantee.
chartSingle: A single recorded price is not a trend.
loadedPageOnly: Sorting applies to the current API page.
adminTiersHelp: The amounts people see on the site for each level. The membership gate itself is set on Narrax: set the same numbers on the matching Narrax membership token gates, or what users see will not match who gets in.
adminClosesHelp: After this time nobody new can join early access. Seats already held keep working. Leave empty for no end date.
adminAccessDaysHelp: How long a self-joined early-access seat lasts. Leave empty for seats that do not expire.
adminTiersOrder: Each level must ask for more tokens than the one below it.
adminTiersPreview: Shown to users as: Member {member}, Pro {pro} {symbol}
adminErrClosed: The early-access window has ended. Move the closing time later or clear it.
alertsBody: Notifications for you: new narratives, shifts and signals. Marking one read only changes your own list.
analyticsBody: What happened after past agent decisions. Small samples are labelled; none of this is a promise of future results.
agentBody: Ask the research assistant about narratives, tokens and evidence. It explains data; it cannot place orders.
settingsBody: Your display name, appearance and which alerts you receive.

anCoverage.priceOnly: These are token-price movements after agent decisions, not account P&L or executed orders. A price rise after SELL or IGNORE is not a successful sell or avoidance signal.
anCoverage.counts: {read} outcome records read → {independent} independent observations (at least 24h apart per token). {known} of {final} completed measurements have a known 24h result. Counts and unavailable rate use this independent sample; awaiting-first-measurement decisions are separate.
anCoverage.awaitingHelp: Some decisions have no outcome record yet. They may be too recent or awaiting the measurement worker; they are not counted as losses or included in performance statistics.
anCoverage.noTradeCost: For this action, results are raw token-price changes. No hypothetical order or trading cost is assumed.
anCoverage.labels: WIN / LOSS / FLAT label the raw 24h price change (+10% / ?10% thresholds). Positive-return rate counts results above zero in the summary return series. These are different measures, not account win rates.
anCoverage.noSignals: No completed, known 24h results with reason codes match these filters.
anCoverage.noEntry: No usable price was stored at or within 15 minutes before the decision.
anCoverage.noHorizon: No usable price was stored at or within 30 minutes after the 24h target.
anCoverage.waiting: Waiting for the 24h price and measurement window to complete.
anCoverage.unspecified: The stored result has insufficient price evidence; no more specific reason is available.
anCoverage.rows: Individual recorded outcomes for the selected action and window, before deduplication and costs. Pending rows may contain partial measurements. Missing values are not zero; a missing 1h reading does not invalidate a known 24h result.
anCoverage.noOutcomes: No recorded outcomes match this action and window. Check the awaiting-first-measurement count or choose another filter.
anCoverage.chNotice: Research only. The assistant reads data and explains it. It cannot place orders or change your settings, and it can be wrong.
anCoverage.welcomeBody: Explore narratives, inspect token evidence, and challenge a thesis using the research available in your workspace.
